verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of scheduled execution is the Marketing API note that RSS campaigns send according to their own schedule, which implies a recurring send. That covers one campaign type, not general recurring jobs or workflows. 'Automations' are mentioned only in marketing copy, with no scheduling detail, and a user's wish to automate a monthly export earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedule configuration (intervals or cron-like), scheduling of general workflows or automations beyond RSS campaigns, explicit recurrence semantics, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: For RSS Campaigns, the campaign will send according to its schedule.
